_doc: Low horizontal slash, starts on the arm's RIGHT, ends on its LEFT (the mirror of ATTACK_LOW_LR). Was 'mirror_of' ATTACK_LOW_LR; made standalone on 2026-09-12 so the end pose can be captured (the mirror IK cannot pitch the blade flat here: the wrist sits at its -94 limit, so the tip pointed up relative to what the user wanted). captured.start = the old mirrored windup, unchanged; captured.end = same hand position, blade tilted 7 deg lower. end/start/roll below are the mirrored numbers and are only used if a captured entry is deleted.

_help.end.x: hand distance forward at the end of the slash (m, keep <= 0.27)
_help.end.z: height of the low line (m above the base plane)
_help.end.pan: where the slash ends (deg; negative = own left)
_help.start.dx: windup hand offset from the end, forward (m; negative = pulled back)
_help.start.dz: windup hand offset from the end, up (m)
_help.start.pan: where the slash starts (deg; + = own right)
_help.roll: wrist roll: -90 = jaw swings sideways on this side (keep -90)
_help.jaw_open: how wide the sword cocks before the sweep (0..100): smaller = comes from less wide
_help.t_windup: seconds: rest -> cocked low on the start side (0.85 = the old mirror timing)
_help.captured.start: windup pose (real degrees): the old mirrored windup, kept so only the end changes. Delete to recompute from start.*
_help.captured.end: end pose (real degrees): hand at (0.27, 0.08), blade pitched -14 deg (was -7: tip pointed up a bit). Delete to recompute from end.*
